Short answer

To install omatrack on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omatrack. It is a 4.9 MB download (14.2 MB installed), version 1.8.6-2, licensed MIT. Cross-format motorsport telemetry analysis workstation. Free and open source.

Install omatrack on Omarchy

Omatrack is a desktop app for analyzing racing telemetry: it imports data from Pi/Cosworth, MoTeC, Racelogic, and AiM loggers and normalizes it all into one consistent per-lap model, so you can overlay traces, compare a lap against a reference lap, and step through corner-by-corner braking, turn-in, apex, and throttle data with synchronized onboard video. Sessions are organized by track, date, and session, and it can pull footage and logs straight from cloud storage (WebDAV, S3, Google Cloud Storage) instead of only local files.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omatrack
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.8.6-2:
    pacman -Qi omatrack

Open and use omatrack

omatrack is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql omatrack | grep applications

omatrack requirements and compatibility

  • Telemetry/video files from a supported logger (Pi/Cosworth, MoTeC, Racelogic, or AiM) to have anything to analyze

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omatrack on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omatrack. The download is 4.9 MB and it takes 14.2 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omatrack free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omatrack?

Run omarchy pkg drop omatrack. It removes the package from your system.

What does omatrack depend on?

The package declares 7 dependencies: qt6-base, qt6-declarative, mpv, libyaml, gcc-libs, glibc, hicolor-icon-theme. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omatrack a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for omatrack.

Is omatrack in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omatrack (version 1.8.6-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Tobias Lütke makes it. Project site: https://github.com/tobi/omatrack.
